opening.argument: The headline promises “7000% Monthly” from a sandwich-frontrunning bot, while the description gives viewers a direct path to “Visit https://www.mevengine.com,” buy and download the software, and deploy it on a node. The promotion describes rapid profit extraction—frontrunning a targeted transaction with a higher fee—and presents daily profits and simple setup as available to a non-developer individual. It also urges viewers, “Download your own Sandwich Tool today!” Those claims and instructions promote a trading bot or funded-contract return opportunity as readily accessible. The warning about impersonators directing users to fund a Remix smart contract does not verify the advertised returns, the software’s performance, or any transaction outcome.
